items.title_en: ‘Meri Tabiyat Bhi Kharab Thi...’: Indian Mom-To-Be Stopped At Thailand Airport; Can You Fly In Pregnancy?
items.title_zh: “Meri Tabiyat Bhi Kharab Thi...”：印度准妈妈在泰国机场被拦截；怀孕期间可以坐飞机吗？
items.summary_en: An Indian woman faced boarding issues in Thailand due to pregnancy, highlighting travel rules for pregnant women across airlines like Air India, Thai Airways, and IndiGo.
items.summary_zh: 一名印度妇女因怀孕而在泰国面临登机问题，该报告强调了印度航空、泰国航空和靛蓝航空等航空公司针对孕妇的旅行规则。
